name: agentguard-monorepo
description: AgentGuard: Agentic Risk & Spend Control Layer for Monad Metropolis

scripts.compile: npm run compile:contracts && npm run build && npm run check:gateway
scripts.lint: npm run lint:zero-mock && npm run lint:theme && npm run lint:ui && npm run lint:erc7730 && npm run lint:contracts && npm run lint:ts && npm run lint:gateway
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node --test contracts/test/agentguard-contracts.test.mjs contracts/test/circuit-vault.test.mjs apps/web/test/frontend.test.mjs packages/x402-middleware/test/middleware.test.mjs services/opensigner/test/opensigner.test.mjs packages/cli/test/cli.test.mjs packages/mcp-server/test/mcp.test.mjs
scripts.preflight: npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test
